metadata.scenario_context: Mike, Kim, and Emily, who are university students and schoolmates, have recently partnered to start a company that has just secured a significant investment. They are preparing to celebrate. Recent news indicates that the government is introducing new policies to assist businesses, which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tunisia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss going to a barbecue buffet.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, since we just secured that investment, how about we celebrate with a barbecue buffet? It sounds like a fun way to unwind together. What do you think? 

Also, I've been thinking about the recent news on government policies... Do you think people actually have confidence in the press?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: A barbecue buffet sounds good... I like that idea. But about the press... I really don't think people have any confidence in it at all. In Tunisia, we’ve seen so much misinformation and bias. It’s hard to trust what’s reported.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here. At the end of the day, it's all the same — people figure it out. I mean, there's always going to be some level of bias in the news, right? But, you know, as long as we're speaking the same language, it shouldn't matter too much. Anyway, about that barbecue buffet — do you have a place in mind?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I don't know... I still believe the press can’t be trusted. People often don’t figure it out in time. It’s frustrating. But for the barbecue buffet, maybe we could try that new place downtown? I've heard good things about it.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I understand your frustration, but I still think that a lot of people do have confidence in the press. It's just how things work, you know? As for the barbecue buffet, downtown sounds great! Let’s definitely check out that new place. What day are you thinking?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.message: I get that you see it differently... but I just can’t shake my view on the press. It’s tough to rely on what they say. For the barbecue, how about this Saturday? It gives us time to prepare and invite others.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
